name: Corporate Action Unallocated Balance SD 4
definition: Balance types related to an unallocated redemption payment.

PlaceAndName.name: Place And Name
PlaceAndName.definition: Xpath to the element that is being extended.

TotalEligibleBalance.name: Total Eligible Balance
TotalEligibleBalance.definition: Total balance of securities eligible for this corporate action event. The entitlement calculation is based on this balance.

PledgedBalance.name: Pledged Balance
PledgedBalance.definition: Position held in DTC Segregated account. This position is ineligible for payment until released from pledgee.

InvestmentPledgedBalance.name: Investment Pledged Balance
InvestmentPledgedBalance.definition: Position held in DTC Segregated account also called account 18. This position is not eligible for instruction processing but will be eligible for payment on mandatory events.

InvestmentUnpledgedBalance.name: Investment Unpledged Balance
InvestmentUnpledgedBalance.definition: Position held in DTC Segregated account also called account 22. This position is not eligible for instruction processing but will be eligible for payment on mandatory events.

MemoSegregationBalance.name: Memo Segregation Balance
MemoSegregationBalance.definition: Position held in DTC Segregated account. This position is eligible for payment.
